item.title: AAERE
item.description: Professor Yangsiyu Lu attended the 15th Congress of the Asian Association of Environmental and Resource Economics (AAERE), held in Jakarta, Indonesia, on August 20–21, and delivered an academic presentation titled “Shine on Small Mines: Size-Based Economic Effects of Coal Mine Closure.”
